name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3
description: Thumb-sized ESP32-S3 board (21 × 17.8 mm, USB-C) with Wi-Fi / BLE (not emulated), 8 MB flash, 11 GPIOs on the headers (D0 to D10), I2C, SPI and UART, an orange user LED (GPIO21, active low) and a built-in Li-ion charger (SGM40567, 50 mA) with BAT pads underneath. Runs real arduino-esp32 firmware in Espressif's QEMU on your computer (Docker). Pin ids are the GPIO numbers (GPIO1 = D0 …, GPIO43 = D6); in code use D0…D10 or the GPIO number. 3.3 V logic only.

availability.reason: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-11 (packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts, board seeed-xiao-esp32s3): real arduino-esp32 3.3.12 firmware built by Faber's own pipeline boots in Espressif's QEMU; GPIO output, GPIO input with the internal pull-up, and Serial (UART0) reach Faber's parts. Run on the merged jb5 emulator sources (a native QEMU build; the faber/qemu-esp:9.2.2-20260417-jb5 Docker image itself is not built yet). Per-peripheral status: docs/boards.md.

pins.label: D0/A0
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO1; McuBackend pin "GPIO1" (pinMode(1, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D0 / A0 (ADC1, touch T1).

pins.label: D1/A1
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO2; McuBackend pin "GPIO2" (pinMode(2, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D1 / A1 (ADC1, touch T2).

pins.label: D2/A2
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO3; McuBackend pin "GPIO3" (pinMode(3, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D2 / A2 (ADC1). Strapping pin (JTAG source when the eFuse selects it; harmless otherwise).

pins.label: D3/A3
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO4; McuBackend pin "GPIO4" (pinMode(4, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D3 / A3 (ADC1).

pins.label: D4/SDA
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO5; McuBackend pin "GPIO5" (pinMode(5, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D4 / SDA: Wire SDA.

pins.label: D5/SCL
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO6; McuBackend pin "GPIO6" (pinMode(6, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D5 / SCL: Wire SCL.

pins.label: D6/TX
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO43; McuBackend pin "GPIO43" (pinMode(43, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D6 / TX: UART0 TX (Serial1 on the real board; in Faber's simulator build Serial goes here too).

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: VBUS: 5 V from the USB-C port when plugged in (faber.json power.usb, default plugged). Without USB it is an input (4.5 to 5.5 V); on battery this pad stays at 0 V (the charger never back-feeds it).

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board LDO (about 0.25 V dropout). Keep loads modest (Faber checks 500 mA). The ESP32-S3 runs down to about 3.0 V.

pins.label: D10/MOSI
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO9; McuBackend pin "GPIO9" (pinMode(9, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D10 / MOSI: SPI MOSI.

pins.label: D9/MISO
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO8; McuBackend pin "GPIO8" (pinMode(8, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D9 / MISO: SPI MISO.

pins.label: D8/SCK
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO7; McuBackend pin "GPIO7" (pinMode(7, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D8 / SCK: SPI SCK.

pins.label: D7/RX
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO44; McuBackend pin "GPIO44" (pinMode(44, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D7 / RX: UART0 RX.

pins.label: BAT+
pins.description: Battery pad on the underside (+, the pad farther from USB): a 1S LiPo / Li-ion cell (3.7 V). The board's SGM40567 charger charges it from USB at 50 mA (3.8 mA trickle below 2.9 V, CV at 4.2 V); without USB the cell powers the board through its power path.

pins.label: BAT−
pins.description: Battery − pad on the underside (the pad nearer USB). Same node as GND.

footprint: 21 × 17.8 mm castellated module, 2 × 7 pins at 0.1 in, rows 0.6 in apart, BAT pads underneath

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply wired to its power pins keeps the 3.3 V rail up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
User LED (orange, GPIO21, active low; LED_BUILTIN) brightness 0..1.
The on-board SGM40567 charger is charging the cell on BAT (charge LED lit).
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_GPIO2 (only on the firmware board).

strapping.note: GPIO3 (D2) selects the JTAG source only when the eFuse asks for it; on a stock XIAO anything may pull it.

toolchain.simNote: The simulator build sends Serial to UART0 (USB CDC On Boot: Disabled) and uses DIO flash, because the emulator has no USB serial and no QIO flash. The factory pack builds the board's own settings: Serial on the USB-C port.

features.description: orange user LED (GPIO21); set expose true for a light pipe
red charge LED (lit while the battery charges)
U.FL connector for the external antenna (keep metal away)
